repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
wait until(not (all(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity < 50))
fired = false
}
wait until(all(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity < 50)
all(#Dehumidifier).dehumidifier_setDehumidifierMode("drying")
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a periodic `if` check at the start of every 1-second iteration. The IR requires a rising-edge wait (`wait(cond, rising)`), which means the action must fire exactly when the condition transitions from false to true, even if that happens mid-period. The candidate fails to observe or react to a rising edge occurring after the initial `if` check but before the next period starts.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the standard rising-edge state machine: persist a `fired` flag, block until the condition is false if previously fired, block until the condition is true, execute the body, and update the flag. This ensures the action fires precisely on the rising edge within the 1-second cycle window.
